campaign.name: First spark
campaign.lesson: Tap the dark tile to turn it. Match its openings to the light.

campaign.name: A gentle bend
campaign.lesson: Corners bend light. Turn each corner until the glow reaches the exit.

campaign.name: Turn it back
campaign.lesson: Press and hold a tile, or right-click it, to turn it back the other way.

campaign.name: Every star
campaign.lesson: Light every tile and let none escape: a sealed board earns a third star.

campaign.name: Ember path
campaign.lesson: Every opening must meet another for a third star.

campaign.name: Wick and glass
campaign.lesson: Light every tile and let none escape.

campaign.name: Lamplight
campaign.lesson: Start where the light already is and work outward.

campaign.name: Night window
campaign.lesson: End tiles glow like stars once light reaches them.

campaign.name: The long hall
campaign.lesson: An edge tile cannot open outward unless an inlet or outlet is there.

campaign.name: Light the Lantern
campaign.lesson: Corners bend light; straights carry it on.

campaign.name: True north
campaign.lesson: Pinned tiles never turn. Read them first, then build around them.

campaign.name: Fixed points
campaign.lesson: Pinned tiles at the edge are the easiest place to start.

campaign.name: Needle and dial
campaign.lesson: Work outward from each pinned tile.

campaign.name: Bearing east
campaign.lesson: Two pinned tiles can hold a whole corridor in place.

campaign.name: Waypoints
campaign.lesson: A pinned tile tells you where its neighbours must open.

campaign.name: Pole star
campaign.lesson: Pinned tiles at the edge are the easiest place to start.

campaign.name: Magnetic
campaign.lesson: Work outward from each pinned tile.

campaign.name: The meridian
campaign.lesson: Two pinned tiles can hold a whole corridor in place.

campaign.name: Dead reckoning
campaign.lesson: A pinned tile tells you where its neighbours must open.

campaign.name: Find the Compass
campaign.lesson: Pinned tiles at the edge are the easiest place to start.

campaign.name: First crossing
campaign.lesson: A bridge lets two beams cross without touching. Light keeps to its own channel.

campaign.name: Over and under
campaign.lesson: A bridge is open on all four sides: its neighbours must face it.

campaign.name: Two roads
campaign.lesson: Follow one beam across, then the other.

campaign.name: The arch
campaign.lesson: Both channels of a bridge need light for a third star.

campaign.name: River lights
campaign.lesson: A bridge is open on all four sides: its neighbours must face it.

campaign.name: Keystone
campaign.lesson: Follow one beam across, then the other.

campaign.name: Span
campaign.lesson: Both channels of a bridge need light for a third star.

campaign.name: Lantern bridge
campaign.lesson: A bridge is open on all four sides: its neighbours must face it.

campaign.name: Crossroads
campaign.lesson: Follow one beam across, then the other.

campaign.name: Cross the Bridge
campaign.lesson: Both channels of a bridge need light for a third star.

campaign.name: Glancing light
campaign.lesson: A mirror bounces light around a corner. Turn it to choose where each beam goes.

campaign.name: Reflection
campaign.lesson: Try the mirror both ways and watch which tiles light.

campaign.name: Mirror lake
campaign.lesson: A mirror carries two beams at once, one on each face.

campaign.name: Tail of fire
campaign.lesson: A mirror is open on all four sides; only its angle changes.

campaign.name: Bounce
campaign.lesson: Try the mirror both ways and watch which tiles light.

campaign.name: Orbit
campaign.lesson: A mirror carries two beams at once, one on each face.

campaign.name: Perihelion
campaign.lesson: A mirror is open on all four sides; only its angle changes.

campaign.name: Long ellipse
campaign.lesson: Try the mirror both ways and watch which tiles light.

campaign.name: Return
campaign.lesson: A mirror carries two beams at once, one on each face.

campaign.name: Catch the Comet
campaign.lesson: A mirror is open on all four sides; only its angle changes.

campaign.name: First rainbow
campaign.lesson: A prism splits white light: amber ▲ turns left, mint ● goes straight, violet ■ turns right.

campaign.name: Three ways
campaign.lesson: White light must enter the prism through its flat back.

campaign.name: Split light
campaign.lesson: Follow each colour out of the prism to its receiver.

campaign.name: Spectrum
campaign.lesson: Each receiver needs exactly its colour. A stray beam spoils it.

campaign.name: Refraction
campaign.lesson: White light must enter the prism through its flat back.

campaign.name: Colour wheel
campaign.lesson: Follow each colour out of the prism to its receiver.

campaign.name: Glass and sun
campaign.lesson: Each receiver needs exactly its colour. A stray beam spoils it.

campaign.name: Bright angle
campaign.lesson: White light must enter the prism through its flat back.

campaign.name: Dispersion
campaign.lesson: Follow each colour out of the prism to its receiver.

campaign.name: Turn the Prism
campaign.lesson: Each receiver needs exactly its colour. A stray beam spoils it.

campaign.name: First blend
campaign.lesson: Where colours meet, they mix. A ▲■ receiver needs amber and violet together, and nothing else.

campaign.name: Two become one
campaign.lesson: A prism absorbs light that reaches its coloured faces.

campaign.name: Dusk
campaign.lesson: Find where two colours meet first.

campaign.name: Coronet
campaign.lesson: Mixed light reaches every tile in its region.

campaign.name: Jewel light
campaign.lesson: A prism absorbs light that reaches its coloured faces.

campaign.name: Royal blend
campaign.lesson: Find where two colours meet first.

campaign.name: Gilded
campaign.lesson: Mixed light reaches every tile in its region.

campaign.name: Diadem
campaign.lesson: A prism absorbs light that reaches its coloured faces.

campaign.name: Coronation
campaign.lesson: Find where two colours meet first.

campaign.name: Raise the Crown
campaign.lesson: Mixed light reaches every tile in its region.

campaign.name: Two lights
campaign.lesson: Two inlets, two colours. Keep the beams apart and feed each receiver its own light.

campaign.name: Side by side
campaign.lesson: Bridges and mirrors let two networks pass through each other.

campaign.name: Binary
campaign.lesson: Match each receiver to the inlet that can reach it.

campaign.name: Gemini
campaign.lesson: Each inlet lights only its own network.

campaign.name: Parallel
campaign.lesson: Bridges and mirrors let two networks pass through each other.

campaign.name: Twin flames
campaign.lesson: Match each receiver to the inlet that can reach it.

campaign.name: Orbiting pair
campaign.lesson: Each inlet lights only its own network.

campaign.name: Mirror twins
campaign.lesson: Bridges and mirrors let two networks pass through each other.

campaign.name: Double star
campaign.lesson: Match each receiver to the inlet that can reach it.

campaign.name: Join the Twins
campaign.lesson: Each inlet lights only its own network.

campaign.name: Gatekeeper
campaign.lesson: A filter passes only its colours. Use it to strip a beam to what a receiver needs.

campaign.name: Tinted glass
campaign.lesson: Filters work in both directions.

campaign.name: Passage
campaign.lesson: Check what colour reaches a filter before you trust it.

campaign.name: Customs of light
campaign.lesson: A filter absorbs the colours it does not pass.

campaign.name: Sails
campaign.lesson: Filters work in both directions.

campaign.name: Open water
campaign.lesson: Check what colour reaches a filter before you trust it.

campaign.name: Signal flags
campaign.lesson: A filter absorbs the colours it does not pass.

campaign.name: Far shore
campaign.lesson: Filters work in both directions.

campaign.name: Starward
campaign.lesson: Check what colour reaches a filter before you trust it.

campaign.name: Guide the Voyager
campaign.lesson: A filter absorbs the colours it does not pass.
